newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican peso closes up after apathetic session.
newsitem.headline: Mexican peso closes up after apathetic session.

text.p: Mexico's peso closed slightly higher on Tuesday, bid up by local dealers in wafer-thin pre-holiday trade despite bearish inflation data.
The 24- and 48-hour contracts closed up 0.1 of a centavo and 0.45 of a centavo at 7.8310/7.8330 and 7.8330/7.8380 per dollar, respectively.
The currency managed to withstand a sharp rise in first-half December inflation, a resilience that one trader put down to "Christmas good cheer."

Despite the 2.34 percent CPI rise, traders were confident that the monthly figure would come out close to an acceptable 3.2 percent because most of the price increases were concentrated in the early part of the month.
